tasks.label: Beyond: Start Menu Studio
tasks.command: bash -lc 'fuser -k 5174/tcp 2>/dev/null || true; (for i in $(seq 1 80); do if curl -fsS http://127.0.0.1:5174/ >/dev/null 2>&1; then if command -v gh >/dev/null 2>&1 && [ -n "${CODESPACE_NAME:-}" ]; then gh codespace ports visibility 5174:public -c "$CODESPACE_NAME" >/tmp/beyond-port.log 2>&1 || true; fi; URL="https://${CODESPACE_NAME}-5174.${GITHUB_CODESPACES_PORT_FORWARDING_DOMAIN}/dev/menu-studio-v3-draft"; echo; echo "BEYOND MENU STUDIO READY"; echo "$URL"; if [ -n "${BROWSER:-}" ]; then "$BROWSER" "$URL" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; fi; break; fi; sleep 0.5; done) & exec npm run dev -- --host 0.0.0.0 --port 5174'
